title: Report: If Ricky Pearsall requires surgery, it will keep him out for all of 2026

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Report: If Ricky Pearsall requires surgery, it will keep him out for all of 2026
sources.description: 49ers wide receiver Ricky Pearsall is out of practice due to swelling in his knee related to the PCL injury he suffered during the 2025 season and the 49ers said on Wednesday that they are considering all options to address the injury.
